label: Connection
description: Connect your Customer.io workspace. Find the Site ID and API key in Customer.io under Account Settings → API Credentials → Track API keys.

fields.label: Test connection
fields.hint: Checks the saved Site ID and API key with Customer.io

fields.label: Send data to Customer.io
fields.description: While this is on, customers and their order, shipment, cart and subscription events are sent to your workspace as they happen.

actions.label: Sync existing customers
actions.hint: Sends every customer of this store to Customer.io

modal.title: Sync existing customers
modal.description: Sends every customer of this store to Customer.io as a person, with their current details. Customers who are already there are updated, never duplicated, and nobody's subscription status is changed. New and changed customers are sent automatically, so you only need this once.
